name: Trackmania (2020)
author: pelican@stather.me
description: Trackmania is a free-to-play game that combines racing and creation. Compete on over 1000 community-made tracks, create your own with the editor, and join clubs and events online.

variables.name: Master Server Login
variables.description: Login to https://www.trackmania.com/player/dedicated-servers to make a login and password

install.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Server files: /mnt/server
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

wget http://files.v04.maniaplanet.com/server/TrackmaniaServer_Latest.zip
unzip -o TrackmaniaServer_Latest.zip
rm TrackmaniaServer_Latest.zip
chmod 755 TrackmaniaServer

cp -n UserData/Config/dedicated_cfg.default.txt UserData/Config/dedicated_cfg.xml
cp -n UserData/Maps/MatchSettings/example.txt  UserData/Maps/matchsettings.xml
echo "Finished Installing."
